formulations.Polymer system Notes: High-molecular-weight poly(trimethylene carbonate) homopolymer synthesized by bulk ring-opening polymerization of trimethylene carbonate with Sn(Oct)2 catalyst at 130 °C for 3 days; residual monomer <7‰; amorphous (no melting endotherms, VTF behavior); rubbery, transparent, self-standing films; pure PTMC Tg ≈ -15 °C.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Conductivity follows VTF behaviour over the whole tested range (room temperature to 79 °C); fits shown as dashed lines in Fig. 2a
formulations.Notes: Solution cast from anhydrous acetonitrile into Teflon mould; solvent evaporated under N2 flow for 3 days, then vacuum oven 60 °C for 2 days. LiTFSI dried at 120 °C for 3 days before use. Mn from GPC in chloroform vs. polystyrene standards. Sample name PTMCnLiTFSI, n = carbonate:Li molar ratio.
formulations.Reference: B. Sun, J. Mindemark, K. Edström, D. Brandell, Polycarbonate-based solid polymer electrolytes for Li-ion batteries, Solid State Ionics (2013)
